Accessibility

  • Every CTA is a real button with a full label, e.g. “Go to Battle #156: it’s live and you haven’t voted yet. Opens another post.”
  • Visible white focus ring on all new controls; dark text on lime keeps contrast high.
  • The pulsing dot on the pill switches off under “reduce motion”.
  • Logged-out viewers get “WATCH #156” instead of a vote button that can’t work.

Header pillabout half a day

Plan: more than one battle open at once

A short summary of how row A1 above could become real.

Why

Today only one battle is open at a time, because posting the next battle closes the previous one. So the “another open battle you haven’t voted in” state (row A1) can’t happen yet.

Proposed model

We keep posting one battle a day, as now, but each battle stays open for a fixed 48 hours, so two are open at once. Battles close on a timer, not when the next one posts.

Streaks: “catch-up until close”

  • Still one vote per battle day.
  • A vote counts any time while that battle is open.
  • You only miss a day when a battle closes without your vote.
  • So the “what next” button also helps your streak.
  • Flairs come at the same pace as today.

What the “what next” button offers

The open battle you haven’t voted in that closes soonest. Tapping it opens that battle’s post.

Rough size

About 3 weeks of work, plus a 1-week trial on r/ums_maps.

Questions for Margaret

  1. Should battles stay open 48 hours or 72 hours?
  2. How should we show a streak that depends on a vote in the other open battle? For example, the streak footer on a post you voted in, while you still haven’t voted in the other open battle.
